summary: First round over plan r2. Five of six seats succeeded (Claude, Codex, Qwen, Kimi, GLM); Gemini's output was malformed. Codex voted block; Claude, Qwen, Kimi and GLM voted revise. Four concerns reached agreement: LR2 misdescribes the packaged example's verify document (Claude, Codex, Qwen); the lint gate and H22 are stale against project.md (Codex, Kimi); D7 (b) changes the default text (Codex, GLM); and section 1 paths lack the src/gnd/ prefix (Claude, Kimi, GLM). The driving agent re-checked the contested facts: Qwen's claim that verdicts carry no `verdict` field is refuted by the live report (`"verdict": "fail"`); Kimi's claim that includes resolve against the working directory is refuted (a run from the parent directory exits 1), though the vocabulary must be staged beside the model because it lives in depth_fixture; whole-repository ruff exits 0; derivation failures do set exit 1 (_reports.py:113-116); assurance_report.py does report precision and recall against an answer key. Claude and GLM share one CLI codebase; Kimi's response is retained as incomplete (nothing dropped).
